+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from openlibrary.plugins.upstream import checkins
+from openlibrary.plugins.upstream.checkins import (
+    check_ins,
+    make_date_string,
+    patron_check_ins,
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ('year', 'month', 'day', 'expected'),
+    [

+        (2000, None, 9, '2000'),
+        (2000, 2, None, '2000-02'),
+        (2000, 2, 9, '2000-02-09'),
+    ],
+)
+def test_module_make_date_string(year, month, day, expected):
+    assert make_date_string(year, month, day) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ('data', 'expected'),
+    [
+        ({'id': 1, 'year': 2000}, True),
+        ({'id': 1, 'data': {}}, True),
+        ({'id': 1, 'month': 2, 'day': 9}, False),
+        ({'year': 2000, 'data': {}}, False),
+        ({'id': 1}, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_patron_check_ins_validation(data, expected):
+    assert patron_check_ins().is_valid(data) is expected
+
+
+def test_patron_check_ins_updates_owned_event(monkeypatch):
+    changes = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.web,
+        'data',
+        lambda: json.dumps(
+            {'id': 1, 'year': 2000, 'month': 2, 'day': 9, 'data': {'note': 'done'}}
+        ).encode(),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(checkins, 'get_current_user', lambda: {'key': '/people/reader'})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents,
+        'select_all_by_username',
+        lambda username: [{'id': 1}] if username == 'reader' else [],
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents,
+        'update_event_date',
+        lambda event_id, value: changes.append(('date', event_id, value)),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins.BookshelvesEvents,
+        'update_event_data',
+        lambda event_id, value: changes.append(('data', event_id, value)),
+    )
+
+    patron_check_ins().POST()
+
+    assert changes == [
+        ('date', 1, '2000-02-09'),
+        ('data', 1, {'note': 'done'}),
+    ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('body', [{'id': 1}, {'year': 2000}])
+def test_patron_check_ins_rejects_incomplete_updates(monkeypatch, body):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(checkins.web, 'data', lambda: json.dumps(body).encode())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(checkins.web, 'badrequest', lambda message: message)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        checkins,
+        'get_current_user',
+        lambda: pytest.fail('Invalid request should be rejected before user lookup'),
+    )
+
+    response = patron_check_ins().POST()
+
+    assert response == 'Invalid request'
